title: One-to-ones: cadence, whose agenda it is, and what gets written down

videos.script: Paula has had a one-to-one every week for a year. Her old manager read the board aloud, and asked if she was blocked. {{title}} She stopped bringing anything to it. The meeting still happened. It just held nothing. {{board}} Renata takes the meeting over, and says three things first. This is your time. I will not ask about tickets, because I can read the board. And let's keep a shared page of topics. {{three}} For two weeks, Paula brings nothing. In the third, she writes one line. She is the only person who understands the reminder service, and she cannot take a week off. {{topic}} That had been true for a year. There was never a meeting where it fitted. {{year}} This lesson is about that meeting. What it is for, how often, whose agenda it is. And what to write down, and who gets to read it. {{notes}}
